confirm.restoreRevision: Replace the current content with this revision?

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.conflict: Someone else changed this story. Load the latest version, then edit again.

dashboard.healthHint: Published stories missing an SEO description, image or tags
dashboard.topStories: Most read in the last 7 days

editor.headline: Headline
editor.slugHint: Leave empty to generate from the headline. Changing it after publication keeps the old URL working with a redirect.
editor.summaryHint: One or two sentences shown under the headline.
editor.markUpdated: Mark as a substantive update (shows an “Updated” time to readers)

checks.headline: Has a headline
checks.canonical: Canonical URL points to this page
checks.translation: Has a version in the other language

editor.factCheck: Reminder: confirm facts, quotes and sources have been verified before publishing.
editor.translationNote: Translations are never automatic; an editor writes them.
editor.readOnly: You cannot edit this story in its current state.
editor.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded. Check the file and try again.
editor.addTagHelp: Type a tag and press Enter or Add. It is created if it does not exist.

toolbar.imageAltPrompt: Describe the image (alt text) for people who cannot see it

media.uploadHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF. Large photos are compressed automatically; GIFs up to 4 MB.
media.disabled: Media storage (Cloudinary) is not configured, so uploads are disabled.
media.focalHint: Click the part of the image that must stay visible in every crop.

taxonomy.inUse: Tags in use cannot be deleted.
taxonomy.howTitle: How to add a new tag
taxonomy.how1: A tag is a specific topic of a story, such as “Monsoon” or “Budget 2026”. It is narrower than a section (such as National).
taxonomy.how2: Give it a name in both languages. Bangla stories show the Bangla name and English stories the English one; without a name in a language, the tag does not show on that language's site.
taxonomy.how3: Press “+ Add”. The address (slug) is created automatically, and a tag with the same name is not created twice.
taxonomy.how4: While writing, you can also type in the editor's tag box and press Enter (only the story's language is filled; add the other name here later).
taxonomy.how5: Click a tag to rename it or add the other language. × deletes it, unless a story still uses it.
taxonomy.tagExists: A tag with this name already exists.
taxonomy.missingHint: Tags with a red dashed border are missing a name in one language. Click to add it.

homepage.intro: Choose which sections appear on the homepage, in what order and with which layout. The lead story, top stories and breaking banner are set from each story’s homepage controls.

users.name: Name
users.inviteHelp: Give a role by email. If there is no account, one is created and you get a link for them to choose a password.
users.inviteLinkHelp: Send them this link. It is shown only once, and anyone holding it can set the password.
users.inviteExisting: {email} already had an account; the role was updated.

ads.intro: The AdSense publisher id comes from the server environment (NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_CLIENT). Enter the AdSense slot id for each placement and switch it on or off here.
ads.clientMissing: No publisher id is configured: no ads will be shown on the site.

pages.intro: About, contact, editorial policy and similar pages. Nothing is linked or visible on the site until a page is published.
pages.title: Title

preview.title: Preview
preview.notice: Preview: readers cannot see this page.

seo.title: SEO dashboard
seo.intro: On-page SEO score for every published story, the most common issues, and the health of sections and trust pages. Scores are guidance, not a promise of Google rankings.
seo.issuesHint: Click an issue to list only the stories that have it.
seo.trustHint: For news sites Google looks for who publishes, the editorial policy and how corrections are handled.
seo.focusHint: The word or phrase you expect readers to type into Google to find this story.
seo.usesSummary: No SEO description, so the summary is shown

checks.description: Meta description is {length} characters (ideal 70–160, written separately)
checks.keyword_in_description: Keyword appears in the meta description
checks.keyword_in_intro: Keyword appears in the first paragraph
checks.internal_links: Links to other stories on the site: {count}
checks.translation: Version in the other language exists (hreflang)
checks.duplicate_title: Title is not used by another story
checks.duplicate_description: Meta description is not used by another story

calendar.title: Content calendar
calendar.intro: What was published and what is scheduled, day by day.

tools.duplicateConfirm: Create a new draft copy of this story?
tools.noControls: No breaking banner or pinned lead is active.
tools.deleteConfirm: “{title}” will be permanently deleted, with its version history and images used only by this story. This cannot be undone. Delete?

roles.intro: Decide who can do what. To give someone a role, go to Users. Changes take effect within half a minute.
roles.lockedNote: This role is fixed and cannot be changed.
roles.resetConfirm: This role's permissions will go back to their defaults. Continue?

about.author: Writes stories and submits them for publishing.
about.editor: Edits and publishes all stories and runs the homepage.
about.manager: Runs the whole newsroom, homepage and ads, but not user accounts.
about.sub_admin: Everything a manager does, plus users and the audit log, but cannot make anyone an admin or sub-admin.
about.moderator: No permissions yet; add what you need.

perm.article_create: Write stories and edit own drafts
perm.article_edit_any: Edit any story and use the SEO dashboard

curation.intro: Pins, top stories, editor's picks and breaking banners in one place. # is the order: the most recent choice is #1. A green label means readers see it on the homepage now. You can still change these from each story's editor.
curation.leadHelp: Only #1 shows. When its time ends or it is removed, #2 takes over.
curation.noPins: No story is pinned right now.
curation.autoLead: With no pin, the lead is chosen automatically (latest top story or latest story). {title}
curation.topHelp: Four places on the homepage; the first four in this order show (excluding the lead).
curation.picksHelp: Four places on the homepage; the first four in this order show.
curation.showingAsLead: Showing as the lead story (a story never appears twice)
curation.breakingHelp: Shown under the menu on every page; removed automatically when the time ends.
curation.searchHint: Type a few letters of the headline
curation.notLiveHelp: These stories have homepage settings but are not published. They take effect once published.
curation.openPage: See all homepage controls on one page →
curation.showingInTop: Showing in top stories (a story never appears twice)
